summary: Iteration 101 - Payroll Worksheet Testing Complete. All features verified working: (1) New /payroll worksheet layout replaces old payroll experience, (2) Worksheet meta fields (Employee Name, Title, Manager Name, Week Of, Hourly Rate, Overtime Rate) save and persist, (3) 7-row time table edits save and persist through backend, (4) Left adjustments panel edits save and persist through backend, (5) Worksheet totals compute correctly after edits, (6) Export CSV functional with complete data, (7) Print button functional, (8) Backend payroll report/timesheet include updated overtime rate and worksheet data, (9) POST /api/payroll/timeclock-shifts works, (10) No regressions in payroll page load or save flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Payroll.js correctly implements new worksheet layout with inline editing for meta fields, 7-row week table, and adjustments panel
PayrollWorksheetToolbar.js provides employee selector, week picker, and Export CSV/Print/Save buttons with proper data-testid attributes
PayrollAdjustmentsPanel.js renders 10 adjustment rows with date, notes, and amount fields - positive adds pay, negative deducts
PayrollWeekTable.js renders 7 rows (Mon-Sun) with date, day, start time, lunch start/end, end time, and computed regular/overtime/total hours
PayrollWorksheetSummary.js displays computed totals: total time, regular hours, overtime hours, regular pay, overtime pay, gross pay, carryover balance, total adjustments, final total
payrollWorksheet.js helper functions correctly calculate break minutes, row minutes, and summarize worksheet with overtime threshold at 40 hours
payrollExport.js correctly builds CSV and print HTML with all worksheet data including overtime rate
Backend employees.py correctly handles overtime_rate field in employee CRUD operations
Backend POST /api/payroll/timeclock-shifts correctly creates worksheet shifts with lunch_start, lunch_end, break_minutes, and notes
Backend payroll report and timesheet endpoints correctly include overtime_rate in response
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing QA Test Employee Updated with worksheet data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll worksheet feature complete and verified. Employee 'QA Test Employee Updated' has test data: title 'Browser Save Check', manager 'Morgan Lead', hourly rate 22, overtime rate 33, worksheet shifts on 2026-04-13 (Mon), 2026-04-14 (Tue), 2026-04-15 (Wed), and adjustments 'Worksheet bonus' $45 and 'Browser Test Bonus' $75.50. All CRUD operations for timeclock-shifts and payroll transactions working. Export CSV generates complete payroll report with daily breakdown and entry details.
